test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.**

A hallucination is an error in perception that is why it is often _______ mental health issues.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Associated with'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "associated" **means connected or linked to something else.
 
• In this **context, **the phrase "associated with" accurately expresses the relationship between hallucinations and mental health issues.
 
• **Hallucinations** are often found or connected with mental health problems.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is-* 'A hallucination is an error in perception that is why it is often **associated with **mental health issues.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now let's analyze the **other options:**

 
 
• **"Accounted with"** doesn't convey the appropriate meaning in this context. It implies a financial or numerical calculation, which doesn't fit the relationship between hallucinations and mental health issues.
 
• **"Suspended in"** implies a state of being temporarily stopped or hanging in something, which doesn't make sense in the context of hallucinations and mental health issues.
 
• **"Dispose of" **means to get rid of or throw away, which doesn't convey the intended meaning of the sentence.
